summary: Twenty Books need 40 Paper and 20 Animal Hides. There are no trappers in the tropics, so Hides come from the Tropiclands Trading Outpost (4 Glass for 3 Hides): run the existing Glassworks on Firewood Yard sticks, trade about 27 Glass, and make Paper at a Paper Mill.

build_order.note: Build site already placed: 12 Planks + 8 Stone. Staff the existing Sawmill first.
Both build sites are already placed; 8 Planks each.
4 Logs; Glassworks use 3 Sticks per 2 panes.
8 Planks + 12 Stone; 2 Paper + 1 Hide per Book.
Optional 60 Beer: the Outpost also trades 8 Glass for 9 Wheat.

pitfalls: The Author's Stand and both Gift Shops start as placed build sites; they only need materials delivered (28 Planks and 8 Stone in all).
Glass is the bottleneck: the 8 starting panes are worth 6 Hides.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
